entities.summary: The Pararaton, also known as the Katuturanira Ken Angrok, is a 16th-century Javanese historical chronicle written in Kawi. The comparatively short text of 32 folio-size pages contains the history of the kings of Singhasari and Majapahit in eastern Java.
